breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the user's physical misconception. The original prompt incorrectly stated that pressure increases toward the center of curvature. The generated specification repeats this error in its conclusion, stating, 'the pressure on the inner side of the streamline is higher than on the outer side'. The ground truth corrects this by implying the pressure is higher on the outer side, which provides the centripetal force for the curved flow.
